title: Guardian Gear
wikitext:
{{Hatnote|Not to be confused with [[Ancient Weapon]]s.}} {{Infobox Item |image= File:BotW Guardian Sword Icon.png |caption= A Guardian Sword from {{BotW|-}} |pronunciation= |plural= |type= |game= BotW |other= AoC |cost= |value= |location= |uses= {{List| * Attacking [[Enemy|Enemies]] * Defense }} |strength= |durability= |comp= [[Ancient Soldier Gear]] |sample= |theme= }} {{Term/Store|Guardian Gear|Guardian Gear|Series, BotW}},{{Exp Game|BotW}}{{Cite Book|quote= |book= CaC |publisher= |page= 175}} also known as '''Guardian Equipment''',{{Exp Game|BotW}}{{Cite Guide|BotW Nintendo|page= 9}} is a recurring archetype of [[Weapon]] in {{TLoZ Series}}.{{Name Ref|AoC}} ==Location and Uses== ==={{BotW|-}}=== Guardian Gear are a set of weaponry wielded by [[Guardian Scout]]s found in [[Ancient Shrine]]s.{{Cite|{{Big|Guardian Sword}}
A sword often wielded by Guardian Scouts. Its blue energy blade is a product of ancient technology. It's not very durable.|Inventory|BotW}}{{Cite|{{Big|Ancient Battle Axe}}
A weapon used by Guardian Scouts. Its unique blade was forged using ancient technology. Although powerful, its unusual shape causes it to break easily.|Inventory|BotW}}{{Cite|{{Big|Guardian Spear}}
Wielded by Guardian Scouts, this spear has a high piercing power and is a testament to the Sheikah's high level of technology. the spearhead appears only when brandished.|Inventory|BotW}} All pieces of Guardian Gear have a chance to appear in [[Treasure Chest]]s that spawn after scanning the {{BotW}} Series [[Guardian]] [[amiibo]] with the [[Amiibo (Ability)|amiibo]] [[Rune]]. During "A Minor Test of Strength" trials, [[Link]] will encounter [[Guardian Scout II|Guardian Scouts II]], wielding basic Guardian Gear. In "A Moderate Test of Strength" trials, [[Guardian Scout III|Guardian Scouts III]] will wield two intermediate pieces of Guardian Gear. Finally, [[Guardian Scout IV|Guardian Scouts IV]] wielding three advanced pieces of Guardian Gear are found during "A Major Test of Strength" trials. Guardian Gear were made in ancient times with the [[Ancient Technology]] of the [[Sheikah]] tribe.{{Cite|{{Big|Ancient Battle Axe++}}
This ancient battle axe's damage output is scaled up to peak performance. Ancient technology makes it possible to enhance cutting power beyond metal weapons' limits.|Inventory|BotW}}{{Cite|{{Big|Guardian Shield}}
A shield made with ancient Sheikah technology. It can deflect a Guardian Scout's beam.|Inventory|BotW}} At their highest level, they are known to surpass the abilities of their metallic counterparts.{{Cite|{{Big|Guardian Shield++}}
The output level of this shield has been boosted to maximum. Its combat capabilities surpass those of metallic shields, and it can deflect Guardian Scout beams.|Inventory|BotW}} Guardian Shields are known to be able to deflect the beams of Guardian Scouts. Guardian Gear are made out of non-metallic materials that do not attract [[Lightning]] or conduct [[Electricity]], and they cannot be manipulated using [[Magnesis]]. They will float in [[Water (Terrain)|Water]]. They are not combustible, and therefore they will not burn when exposed to [[Fire]] or [[Scorching Climate]]s. ====List of Equipment==== {| class="wikitable" style="width:100%; max-width:57.5em; text-align:center" |- !style="width:25%"| Item !style="width:10%"| Strength !style="width:10%"| Durability !style="width:55%"| Description |- | [[File:BotW Guardian Sword Icon.png|link=]]
